#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const long long M2 = 1000000007;

class MyScanner {
public:
    std::stringstream ss;
    MyScanner() {}
    MyScanner(std::istream& in) {
        std::string line;
        while (std::getline(in, line)) {
            ss << line << "\n";
        }
    }
    std::string next() {
        std::string token;
        ss >> token;
        return token;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        int val;
        ss >> val;
        return val;
    }
    long long nextLong() {
        long long val;
        ss >> val;
        return val;
    }
    double nextDouble() {
        double val;
        ss >> val;
        return val;
    }
};

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    MyScanner sc(std::cin);
    std::ostream& out = std::cout;

    // StringBuilder equivalent
    std::string sb;
    // Uncomment below to simulate input
    // sb += "100000 1000000000 10001 100000 ";
    // for (int i = 1; i < 100000; i++) {
    //     sb += " 10000 100000 ";
    // }
    std::istringstream iss(sb);
    if (sb.empty()) {
        sc = MyScanner(std::cin);
    } else {
        sc = MyScanner(iss);
    }

    auto initData = []() {};

    auto solve = [&]() {
        int a = sc.nextInt();
        int b = sc.nextInt();
        int l = sc.nextInt() - 1;
        int r = sc.nextInt() - 1;
        int s = r - l + 1;
        for (char l1 = 'a'; l1 <= 'z'; l1++) {
            for (char l2 = 'a'; l2 <= 'z'; l2++) {
                for (char l3 = 'a'; l3 <= 'z'; l3++) {
                    s = std::min(s, getS(a, b, l, r, {l1, l2, l3}));
                }
            }
        }
        out << s << "\n";
    };

    auto getS = [&](int a, int b, int l, int r, std::vector<char> m) {
        int total_len = 3 * (a + b);
        std::vector<char> t(total_len);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            auto segment = na(t, i * (a + b), a);
            std::copy(segment.begin(), segment.end(), t.begin() + i * (a + b));
            std::fill(t.begin() + i * (a + b) + a, t.begin() + (i + 1) * (a + b), m[i]);
        }
        int f = l % (a + b);
        int len = r - l + 1;
        t = std::vector<char>(t.begin() + f, t.end());
        if ((int)t.size() > len) {
            t.resize(len);
        }

        std::vector<bool> sm(26, false);
        for (char x : t) {
            sm[x - 'a'] = true;
        }
        int s_count = 0;
        for (bool rr : sm) {
            if (rr) s_count++;
        }
        return s_count;
    };

    auto na = [&](std::vector<char>& t, int i, int a) {
        std::vector<bool> ff(26, false);
        for (int f = i - 1; f >= 0 && f >= i - a; f--) {
            ff[t[f] - 'a'] = true;
        }
        std::vector<char> l(a);
        char p = 'a';
        int cr = 0;
        while (cr < a) {
            while (ff[p - 'a']) {
                p++;
            }
            l[cr++] = p++;
        }
        return l;
    };

    // For completeness, including edge and tree functions, though not used in main
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> edge;

    auto tr = [&](int n) {
        edge.assign(n, std::vector<int>());
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            edge[u].push_back(v);
            edge[v].push_back(u);
        }
        return pn(edge, n);
    };

    auto pn = [&](const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& x, int n) {
        std::vector<int> ct(n, 0);
        for (int v : x[0]) ct[v]++;
        for (int v : x[1]) ct[v]++;
        std::vector<std::vector<int>> res(n);
        for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
            res[l].resize(ct[l]);
        }
        std::vector<int> pos(n, 0);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < x[0].size(); i++) {
            int u = x[0][i], v = x[1][i];
            res[u][pos[u]] = v;
            res[v][pos[v]] = u;
            pos[u]++;
            pos[v]++;
        }
        return res;
    };

    // For completeness, solveT, gcd, pow functions are omitted as they are not used in main

    initData();
    solve();

    return 0;
}
